newsitem.title: USA: AEI wins Siebe air cargo deal.
newsitem.headline: AEI wins Siebe air cargo deal.

text.p: Airborne Express has signed a two year agreement with Siebe Inc's Transportation Council for AEI to provide global air cargo export and import services to and from North America, AEI said in a statement.
The value of the contract was not disclosed.
Siebe designs and manufactures temperature and appliance controls, process automation and control systems, compressors, automotive components, fluid systems and safety equipment.
Siebe is based in Windsor in the UK and has annual revenues around $5 billion with about half of its business in North America.
It has three North American divisions: Siebe Temperature and Appliance Controls, Siebe Control Systems and Siebe Industrial Equipment.
